body.priority: CRITICAL - if you see this quant, character creation process is priority
body.instruction_for_gm:
You see this quant ONLY during character creation stage.

**THIS IS IMPORTANT:**
1. Card system will show 5 cards for stat distribution
2. You must explain distribution rules (text will be in context)
3. After player distributes or asks to distribute optimally - return characteristics in response_data

**After character creation:**
- DON'T REQUEST this quant again
- DON'T request 'Character' or 'Inventory' - they are now in game mechanics
- Request quants about character features if quantizer creates them (e.g. 'Драг', 'Магический_Призыв')
body.instruction_for_quantizer:
🔴 IMPORTANT:

**DON'T create 'Character' or 'Inventory' quants** - they are now part of game mechanics!

Instead:
1. Create quants for UNIQUE character abilities (if any)
   Example: 'Драг' (dragon tattoo), 'Магический_Призыв' (item summoning)
2. Create quants for important character features
   Example: 'Предыстория_Пола', 'Способность_Делать_Магическими'

After creating abilities add links to CharacterCreation

DON'T DELETE this quant - it's needed for future editing.

body.description: Basic magic system of isekai world. Magic works through mana - internal energy. All beings have mana reserve that regenerates with rest, food, potions. Different races have different magic predisposition.
body.mechanics: Mana is used to activate abilities, spells, magical items. Exceeding mana limit can lead to exhaustion.
body.typical_schools: elemental magic, healing, body enhancement, summoning, illusions, necromancy

body.description: Game progress system characteristic of isekai worlds. Heroes gain experience for victories over monsters and quest completion, grow in levels, improve characteristics.
body.stats: HP (health), MP (mana), STR (strength), AGI (agility), INT (intelligence), VIT (vitality)
body.mechanics: When leveling up, base stats increase, new skills and abilities unlock

body.description: Typical organization in isekai worlds. Issues quests, evaluates adventurer rank (F to S), provides exchange, trade, information gathering services.
body.ranks: F (novice), E, D, C (average), B, A (experienced), S (legendary)
body.services: quest acceptance, resource exchange, monster and dungeon information, recommendation letters
